notes.title: Our new game: Magic Forge Tycoon is in open beta now!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings children of the night,[/p][p][/p][p]The minions of Clever Trickster crawl from their coffins to announce the [b]open beta[/b] of their new creation: [b]Magic Forge Tycoon![/b] Sharpened under the gaze of hundreds of picky mortals, it is now time to unleash it upon the world… and let thousands of you poke holes in it with your feedback. 🦇


[i]Pitch: Craft enchanted weapons, experiment to improve quality, trade resources, and shape rival kingdoms’ destinies in this relaxed fantasy tycoon. Fulfill contracts, upgrade your forge, and choose whether to keep peace or stoke war to become Korendor’s most renowned blacksmith.[/i][/p][p]
Your whispers (aka feedback) are precious, even when they reek of garlic. Do not hesitate to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3913240/Magic_Forge_Tycoon_Open_Beta/"]leave the demo a review[/url], scream at us on [url="https://discord.gg/q86SDjeFEg"]Discord[/url], or use the [b]built-in bug report tool[/b] to share your issues, complaints, or even your foolish dreams.[/p][p][/p][p]Why this game, you ask? Because we, too, once feasted on [b]Game Dev Tycoon[/b] and reveled in [b]medieval fantasies[/b]. So we mixed both worlds, sprinkled them with a bit of political scheming (fear not, no global conspiracy here… at least, not yet).[/p][p][/p][p]If you truly wish to help our unholy work: [b]wishlist the game[/b], [b]review the demo[/b], and [b]spread the word to your mortal acquaintances[/b]. In return, you shall have my eternal gratitude… and I might even refrain from sucking you dry. This time.[/p][p][/p][p]Vladimir de la Ligne,[/p][p](Clever Trickster Team)[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3913240/Magic_Forge_Tycoon_Open_Beta/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Oh, and a small mercy worth noting... the flood of Elder feedback has been reduced. I have silenced some of my peers. Not with violence (this time), but with a most ancient technique: disabling their mic permissions. You're welcome.

Now, onto the ritualistic scroll of changes:

[b]Fixed[/b]:
[list]
[*] Elders no longer spawn their feedback bubbles every 5 seconds. Blessed silence at last.[/list]
[b]Added[/b]:
[list]
[*] Invert Mouse Control in Playability menu (Works across UI, furniture placement/rotation, construction, selection, assignation menu... basically everything)

[*] Human customers now prefer rooms matching their theme when searching for a table.
[*] Human customers also prefer tables matching their style. Finally, the décor snobs are satisfied.

notes.title: Bug Fixes - Construction - 6 Months of Post-Launch Support
notes.content:
Greetings, Children of the Night,

Many of you have expressed concerns about bugs and other issues you've encountered, and we want to share our plan to fix everything.

First, we’d like to thank you for your support both before and during the launch. Those positive reviews on Steam mean a lot to us, and we hope to read even more of them! [b]I carefully read every review, both positive and negative[/b]. [i]This is our first game as a studio[/i]—we’ve poured our love, tears, and blood into it. It’s been quite a journey, and we’re proud of what we’ve achieved as a team. But it’s not perfect yet, and we’re working hard to improve it!

Despite extensive QA testing, some pesky bugs still slipped through the net—and that makes us angry. We want to fix them all and become the best bug hunters in the world! Sounds like a Pokémon pitch, but seriously, we're on it. To address the issues, [b]we’ll be deploying several hotfixes—daily if possible—to tackle the most critical problems[/b]. That’s our first move.

Some of you have also expressed concerns about our resources for both fixing bugs and adding new content. [b]We originally budgeted at least six months of post-launch support[/b], even if the game wasn’t a success. But so far, the launch has been great! Blood Bar Tycoon has appeared in News & Trending, Top Sellers, and even front-page sliders—all thanks to you. So, we promise to fix the issues and add new content. We just ask for a little patience, as [b]we’re an indie team working as fast as possible[/b] while avoiding burnout (because exhaustion leads to bugs—it’s the dark side of game development).

Now, let’s talk about the biggest concern: [b]the construction system[/b]. We attempted a hybrid between the Two Point series and The Sims, and in hindsight, it may not have been the best approach. The system needs a major overhaul, but we’ll tackle that after addressing the most critical issues. To ensure we create a system you enjoy, we’ll run beta tests on [url=https://discord.com/invite/q86SDjeFEg]Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fqm.qq.com%2Fq%2FfJjq9TqC3K]QQ[/url], so you can give us direct feedback. We believe involving more of you in this process is the right move. What do you think of this idea?

If you love the game but don’t love the bugs and other issues (trust us, we don’t either), here’s how you can help:

[list]
[*] Use the built-in tool to report issues for our QA.
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/q86SDjeFEg]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fqm.qq.com%2Fq%2FfJjq9TqC3K]QQ[/url] so we can assist you directly and pinpoint issues faster (we’ll owe you one!).
[*] Leave a positive review and mention your concerns (bad reviews won’t help us fix things—quite the opposite).
[/list]

Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to chatting with you on Discord!

Ludovic
Lead Game Designer of Blood Bar Tycoon

notes.title: More about adaptive music in Blood Bar Tycoon (3 days until launch!)
notes.content:
Greetings, children of the night!

Today, I'd like to introduce you to one of the really cool features we've added to Version 1 of Blood Bar Tycoon: adaptive music. But what the hell does that mean?

Our sound studio and sound programmer took on the challenge of creating musical variations for each bar theme. That means 14 variations for each of the two in-game tracks, resulting in a total of 28 different music variations.

But we didn’t stop there: we took it even further! Those 14 variants will seamlessly blend together to reflect your four main bar themes. This means that four different versions of a track will mix dynamically, influenced by the theme distribution of your bar.

If that sounds a bit confusing, here’s an example:
Let’s say your bar is 50% Western, 25% Biker Metal, 15% Dark, and 10% Disco. The music will primarily focus on the Western theme, with elements of Biker Metal, and subtle touches of Dark and Disco. And trust me: the result is amazing!

[b]Some of our playtesters even started designing their bars based on the music they liked best. How cool is that?[/b]

Oh, and some of you have asked if the soundtrack will be available separately. Yes! We're working on a DLC with the official soundtrack, because you asked for it! However, it won’t launch at the same time as V1, since we finished the soundtrack a little too late to align with Steam’s approval process.

[b]Interviewer (V-Diffusion): [/b] Greetings, Hadrian Von Kopek. It's a pleasure to have you with us today. Could you start by telling our readers a little about your background and how you came to manage the Bank SUK?

[b]Hadrian Von Kopek:[/b] Ah, the pleasure is mine, my appetizing host. Ho! Ho! Ho! You see, I hail from a lineage of Austrian nobles. Our wealth grew exponentially during the 18th century, as I strategically acquired my competitors' assets. When I became immortal, I saw our fellows in dire need of proper financial services. Thus, the Bank SUK was born, providing indispensable financial services to our nocturnal society, with the best and only official vampiric loan services on the market!

[b]Interviewer (V-Diffusion): [/b] Fascinating. What differentiates vampire bank services from classical ones for humans?

[b]Hadrian Von Kopek:[/b] It's quite simple, really. Vampires, like anyone else, have financial needs, but they are often more... unique. We require discretion, flexibility, and sometimes a little "bite" in our transactions. Ho! Ho! Ho! The Bank SUK meets these needs impeccably, making us indispensable to our clients. Plus, monopolies do have their advantages... for me, indeed. Ho! Ho! Ho!

[b]Interviewer (V-Diffusion): [/b] Indeed they do. Your previous love for fine cuisine was well-known. Isn't it a big loss since you became a vampire?

[b]Hadrian Von Kopek:[/b] Ah, my dear interviewer, becoming a vampire doesn't mean giving up the finer things in life, it just means adapting. While I may no longer savor earthly delicacies, the variety in human blood is quite remarkable. Different blood types, ages, and even emotional states offer a wide range of flavors. A proper Blood Bar, equipped with the finest tools and techniques, can alter and flavor human blood to create an endless array of culinary delights Ho! Ho! Ho! From a robust, full-bodied vintage to a delicate, sweet infusion, the possibilities are as vast as they are delectable! (Licking his mouth)

[b]Interviewer (V-Diffusion): [/b] Your physical appearance and style are quite distinctive. And the reverse growth of your teeth is sometimes the mockery of vampiric society. What would you say about that?

[b]Hadrian Von Kopek:[/b] How dare you bring up such a personal matter! Do you forget to whom you are speaking? I am the Baron Hadrian Von Kopek! A noble of the highest order! My accomplishments and power far surpass any trivial mockery about my teeth! Let it be known that such insolence will not be tolerated. No one, and I mean no one, should ever mention my teeth again. Excuse yourself here and now, or I'll be your demise!

[b]Interviewer (V-Diffusion): [/b] My deepest apologies, Baron. I meant no disrespect... Let's move on to the next question. How important is it to keep the vampiric society in the shadows?

[b]Hadrian Von Kopek:[/b] Apology accepted, but you owe me a dinner. Now, regarding the necessity of keeping our vampiric society in the shadows, it is of utmost importance due to the proliferation of vampire hunters and the advancements of modern society. While your boss and I may have differing views on this matter, I firmly believe that our survival hinges on secrecy. Exposure would bring chaos and threats from the human world that we are not prepared to handle.

Moreover, it is in the best interest of our society to remain calm and avoid quarrels among Elders. I'm thinking of the recent verbal joust between Miss Arlington and Mr. de Laligne. Disputes and infighting only weaken us and make it more difficult to maintain our hidden existence. Unity and discretion are the pillars of our continued prosperity and safety. And I like to eat my prey warm, alive, and calm. Ho! Ho! Ho!

[b]Interviewer (V-Diffusion): [/b] Thank you, Hadrian Von Kopek, for sharing your insights with us. We look forward to seeing what the future holds for you and the Bank SUK.

[b]Hadrian Von Kopek:[/b]  The pleasure was mine. Remember, in the world of eternal night, the Bank SUK is always here, and you have the whole of eternity to pay us back. Ho! Ho! Ho!

[b]Interviewer of V-Diffusion:[/b] Good evening to all undead watching us. Tonight, we have the pleasure of welcoming Sophie Arlington, the remarkably successful manager of Nocturnal Records, to our studio. Sophie, thank you for joining us.

[b]Interviewer of V-Diffusion:[/b] Sophie, anyone who sees you can't help but admire your success. You have traversed the ages and always show true modernity. How do you do it?

[b]Sophie:[/b] Ah, it’s all about understanding the fine art of balance. In both business and aesthetics, one must have an eye for potential and an appreciation for the finer details. It’s about crafting an environment where art thrives—whether it’s music, the art of presentation, or even more... erotic subjects...

[b]Interviewer of V-Diffusion:[/b] Speaking of thriving, you’ve certainly done so in a cutthroat industry. But let’s address something a bit controversial. Vladimir de Laligne, the nefarious Elder recently returned to Crimson City, has made some harsh claims about you, suggesting you can't be trusted. What do you say to that?

[b]Sophie:[/b] i[/i] Vladimir has always had a penchant for drama, hasn't he? We have a complicated history, dating back to the Prohibition era. While I prefer to focus on the present and he's stuck in the past, it's no secret that I've had to navigate around his... less appealing traits. Let’s just say, if needing to be cautious makes me untrustworthy, then perhaps we need to redefine trust, and he should look into a mirror... if he dares...

[b]Interviewer of V-Diffusion:[/b] Well said. We'll let our viewers decide who should be trusted or not. Obviously, I trust you, my dear.

[b]Sophie:[/b] You're so lovely, my little sugar...

[b]Interviewer of V-Diffusion:[/b] With your undeniable charm and shrewd business sense, it’s no wonder you’ve risen to the top. Is there anything exciting in the pipeline for Nocturnal Records that you can share with us tonight?

b]Sophie:[/b] Oh, there are always exciting projects in the works. We’re exploring new genres and signing artists who embody the spirit of the night. Also, we're planning to launch a tremendous event for the night creatures, with an orgy included, of course. I still need to find the proper blood supplier for the buffet, so if any of your viewers have an entrepreneurial mindset, he, she, or they are welcome to make me a good offer. And here is your invitation, sugar. (She gives a sealed letter to the interviewer)

[b]Interviewer of V-Diffusion:[/b] [i](Enthusiast)[/i] That sounds incredibly exciting! Lastly, for any aspiring artists watching us tonight, what advice would you give them?

[b]Sophie:[/b] Stay true to your vision, embrace the night, and never be afraid to let your true self shine. The music industry needs authenticity now more than ever.

[b]Interviewer of V-Diffusion:[/b] Sophie Arlington, ladies and gentlemen, a true connoisseur of aesthetics. Thank you again for gracing us with your presence tonight, Sophie.

[b]Sophie:[/b] The pleasure was all mine, as always. Thank you, and give my regards to the delightful M. Reyes.

[b]Interviewer of V-Diffusion:[/b] I will. Dear viewers, have a bloody night and see you soon for another interview with the Elders of our fangtastic city!

notes.title: Learn More About the Elders (1/7)
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44862256/2dc1cd976878de22080dddc0a16b657577bfd4dd.jpg[/img]

[b]V-Diffusion Interviewer: [/b]Today, we have an exclusive interview with the mighty Elder: Vladimir de Laligne, leader of the Cryptkins. Vladimir, thank you for joining us.

[b]Vladimir: [/b][i](leans back, removes his mask and smirks)[/i]The pleasure is all yours, I'm sure. Don't forget that I charge by the hour for my illustrious presence.

[b]V-Diffusion Interviewer: [/b] Let's start with your past. You once ran flourishing establishments during the prohibition era. Can you tell us more about that time?

[b]Vladimir:[/b][i](smiling with all his teeth showing)[/i] Ah, the golden days! My bars were the epitome of decadence and excess. Humans, so easily swayed by their desires, flocked to my establishments, unaware that they were mere cattle to me. Their blood flowed freely, and my coffers overflowed with riches. Those were indeed glorious times.

[b]V-Diffusion Interviewer: [/b] So what happened? It's been a while since anyone has heard from you, and Crimson City is in dire need of Blood Bar right now after the hunters last raids.

[b]Vladimir:[/b][i](Grunt and frown)[/i] I don't want to talk about that. But every dark one should know that the wretched beast named Sophie Arlington shouldn't be trusted. [i](Look angry and ready to kill someone)[/i]

[b]V-Diffusion Interviewer: [/b] What are your plans now?

[b]Vladimir:[/b] [i](eyes glinting with greed)[/i] My plans are simple: to reclaim my former glory and wealth. The world has changed, but its essence hasn't. I have my eye on a few promising pawns who will help me rebuild my empire. Through them, I will reconnect with this modern age and reestablish my dominion.

[b]V-Diffusion Interviewer: [/b]You are known for being ruthless. How do you justify your lack of respect for human life? Not all vampires share your point of view on that matter, especially the younger ones.

[b]Vladimir: [/b][i](shrugs) [/i]Humans are mere insects in the grand scheme of things. They exist to serve those who are superior—like me. The nature of all dark ones is that of a predator at the top of the food chain. Respect is for equals, and there are none who stand equal to Vladimir de Laligne. But maintaining secrecy about our existence is crucial. The shadows are where we thrive, undetected and powerful, ensuring our rule remains unchallenged.

[b]V-Diffusion Interviewer: [/b] Finally, what message do you have for those who might dare to oppose you?

[b]Vladimir:[/b] [i](smirking coldly)[/i] To oppose me is to court death. I am a force that cannot be tamed or defeated. Let them try; their efforts will only add to my amusement and my power. In the end, Vladimir de Laligne always prevails! [i](Laughs sinisterly)[/i]

[b]V-Diffusion Interviewer: [/b][i](A little bit afraid)[/i] Thank you, Vladimir. This has been a... revealing conversation.

[b]Vladimir:[/b] [i](stands tall, putting his mask back on to hide his appearance) [/i]Indeed. Now, if you’ll excuse me, I have empires to rebuild. I will send the invoice for this interview to your boss.
